title: Stop the diagnostic-write launcher test from pinning production source text
outcome: Stop the diagnostic-write launcher test from pinning production source text
acceptance: The successful-retention case of the long diagnostic test in scripts/test-launcher-tests/commit-input.mjs no longer depends on the exact text of the launcher's writeFileSync call. Only the refusal case injects the write failure, and a behaviour-preserving rewrite of that call leaves the successful case passing.
disposal_reason: w-15c8af500750 (filed from R58 of w-8f127d78e960) covers this R43 Low and more: it replaces source-substitution fault injection across the launcher tests, including this commit-input.mjs:447 diagnostic-write fixture. One item owns the fix, per Fable #4739.
